title: DC-area forecast: Plenty of sun and comfortable humidity the next few days
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Mostly sunny and nice today for outdoor activities with highs in the low to mid-80s and decreasing humidity.

What’s next? Plenty of sun and comfortable humidity stick around through Wednesday with highs in the 80s. More humid Thursday as a chance of showers and storms returns.

Today’s daily digit — 8/10: Sunshine, a comfy feel, and drier vibes ahead. Enjoy! | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

Forecast in detail

Today (Sunday): A nice-looking day with mostly sunny skies and decreasing humidity. Highs reach the low to mid-80s with very comfortable humidity by afternoon (dew points dropping to the low 60s and upper 50s). Winds are a bit breezy from the west and northwest around 10 to 15 mph. Confidence: Medium-High 😎 Nice Day!

Tonight: Not a bad night to crack the windows for a bit. High pressure builds in and keeps our skies mostly clear. Lighter winds continue to come from the west, dropping humidity even further (dew points in the 50s). Lows range from the upper 50s to mid-60s. Confidence: High

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Monday): Although many of us head back to work and school, the weather won’t be something to complain about. Mostly sunny skies and highs around 80 to 85 make for a beautiful day, plus low humidity with dew points in the 50s — quite pleasant for this time of year. Confidence: Medium-High 😎 Nice Day!

Tomorrow night: Another refreshing night is on tap, with clear skies and lows in the upper 50s to low 60s. Confidence: Medium-High

📬 Get our forecast in your inbox

Our morning forecast email is back! It's included with every level of support — from Free to Sustainer — delivered 7 days a week. Sign up at: capitalweather.com/support-us

A look ahead

Tuesday and Wednesday both look like winners with mostly to partly sunny skies and comfortable humidity. Tuesday highs aim for the low to mid-80s with dew points again in the 50s. Wednesday highs head for the mid-80s with slightly higher humidity, but still on the low side. Both days should be good ones to get outside and enjoy, and maybe tackle some yard work. Lows both nights in the 60s. Confidence: Medium

A more typical August feel with higher humidity returns Thursday. A breeze from the south pushes highs into the mid- to upper 80s, while dew points climb to the mid-60s to near 70. The chance for showers or storms returns by afternoon or evening. Confidence: Low-Medium

The Chesapeake-Potomac Hurricane of 1933

A catastrophic 1933 hurricane devastated the Mid-Atlantic, bringing extreme flooding, a massive storm surge up the Potomac, and widespread destruction that reshaped parts of the Chesapeake Bay coastline.
